text: {"lessons":["I should evaluate each stock by its expected future return and portfolio role, not sell simply because a gain feels satisfying; repeated profit-taking can leave too little exposure to winners.","Selling Stock B at a substantial loss was painful, but I should not let loss aversion keep me from reassessing a holding objectively or make me treat the sale as a mistake by itself.","I should make deliberate, diversified decisions based on risk and evidence rather than reacting to every monthly price move; frequent trading and repeated trims can undermine a coherent plan."]}
